content:
Maya: Quick check-in on Umbria preview enrollment — @Jack we only see 3 active seats out of 12 provisioned. Any blockers on your side?

Jack: Hey Maya, thanks for the ping. We hit an auth issue during SAML setup; security is requesting an IdP cert rotation before we finish. Eng got pulled onto a sprint so delayed.

Tom: @Jack I can take the auth triage tomorrow at 10:00am PT if that works — can we get the SAML metadata before then?

Liz: I uploaded the compact enablement playbook and a 7-step admin checklist here: https://redwood.app/playbooks/umbria-onboard — includes quick screenshots and the minimum smoke tests.

deploy-bot: uploaded enablement-recording-umbria.mp4 (45MB) to /shared/enablements/umbria — recording + captions available.

Jack: 10:00am PT works for us. I'll DM the SAML metadata to Tom after this thread. Also would love a one-pager rubric to show execs how we measure preview success.

Maya: Will do. I'll draft a compact success rubric (usage thresholds, key flows, quality check) and a 2-question NPS-style feedback survey by EOD. Flagging this account as 'watch' for engagement — if usage doesn't pick up by week 3 we'll escalate renewal outreach.

Tom: To speed verification, I'll prep a tiny smoke script we can run once auth is fixed. Example command I'll use:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TEMP_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}'
```

Tom: I'll share it in the call and can run it with the Umbria token.

Liz: Proposed next steps: 1) Tom call at 10:00am PT to unblock SAML, 2) Maya sends rubric + short survey by EOD, 3) Umbria completes admin checklist and confirms seats, 4) follow-up sync in 7 days to review usage.

Maya: I'll create the calendar invite and include the checklist + survey link. Also adding a renewal-risk note to the account so CSM+Sales see it. :thumbsup:

Jack: Confirmed — we'll join the call and send metadata now. Appreciate the quick turnaround, team.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the invite and drop the rubric here once ready.
